context: Party explores Chu Lu Gah's home; Carmine reads his diary. Ancient coin leads to a word riddle. Adjacent E3510-E3519 and E3600-E3609 reviewed.
decisions: Word riddle remains solvable as words emerge from mouths and enter ears. Long narration and dialogue sentences continue across their source rows. Imported rows retained.
provenance: Four exact-match imported rows preserved; 76 new English translations from Japanese source with adjacent context reviewed.

translations.en: Wait. There's something written beside the door.
It's @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r name...
Could this be a nameplate?
If this is his home, I wouldn't expect traps,
but be careful anyway.
Mages are always on their guard,
so being his home doesn't mean it can't be trapped.
Hundreds of years must have passed.
The entire room was covered in dust.
Perhaps preservation spells protected the furniture and books:
a cleaning would make them ready to use right away.
A room where time had stood still.
That seemed a fitting description of this place.
This was probably where the ancient archmage @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
had once lived.
Let me see that a moment.
Is this a diary? It looks like @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r...
@7rCarmine@0r cradled the thick, handwritten book
and began reading it eagerly.
I think it is a diary.
I'll need to read it more carefully later,
but it describes the town before it was sealed.
Apparently, ancient mages sealed something away
and built a facility here to watch over it.
The town began when the families of the facility's keepers settled here,
and it gradually grew from there.
@7rChu Lu Gah@0r arrived here
long after the town was fully established...
@7rChu Lu Gah@0r sensed something strange in the town,
and his investigations with his disciples revealed that the seal here
was on the verge of breaking.
Then he realized that restoring this seal
was beyond his power.
It looks like @7rChu Lu Gah@0r agonized over finding a solution.
He kept wondering what he should do.
Legends describe an indomitable, fearless mage,
but in his diary, @7rChu Lu Gah@0r seems
like an ordinary person you'd meet anywhere...
So why did he choose a method that dragged
everyone in town into it? That crucial point is missing.
I'll have to read it more closely.
Flipping through it here won't give us any answers.
Let's head back, then.
Once I've had time to study it properly,
I'll tell you everything I learn. Don't worry.
You agreed with @7rCarmine@0r
and decided to head back.
An enormous pile of coins lay before you.
Could these be the coins you were looking for?
As you reached toward the coins,
a monster suddenly attacked!!
It seems that mountain of coins
was actually a monster.
You picked up the last remaining coin.
It appeared quite old, but was beautifully decorated.
You obtained an @3rAncient Coin@0r.
To avoid losing the @3rAncient Coin@0r,
you tucked it into the bottom of your bag.
There was a round hole that looked as if a coin would fit.
The coin @7rTanya@0r had given you did seem
to be about the right size.
You tried fitting the coin into it.
As expected, the coin fit perfectly.
It began to glow softly,
and a message like a question appeared in your mind.
"What comes out of the mouth and is swallowed through the ears?"
What is the answer?
Words
Light
Food
Words are the supreme treasure created by the gods.
Books that record them are the ultimate treasure.
That message echoed in your mind,
and the door slowly opened.
Light is swallowed through the eyes.
It isn't swallowed through the ears.
But what on earth had attacked it?
